$comment: FitOS tier-1 primitives and tier-2 semantic mappings. Values are Linear's iOS design system, copied exactly from design-md/productivity/linear/DESIGN.md; the tier architecture is ours. Dark is the default and Linear is dark-first. Verified by check-contrast.mjs — run it after any change. Every deviation from the source spec is listed under $deviations with the reason.

$deviations.light-status-ramp: Linear's spec ships four light values (canvas, surface, text, secondary) and no light status ramp. Amber, red and green at their dark values measure 1.46:1, 3.19:1 and 2.29:1 on the light surface and cannot carry text there. The -on-light entries scale each hue toward black by the smallest factor that clears 4.5:1; the glyph tier clears 3:1. Hue is preserved.
$deviations.purple-tint-flattened: Linear specifies the selection wash as rgba(94,106,210,0.14). It is stored here composited against each theme's canvas, because a known ground makes the result checkable by the contrast gate — an alpha value is not.
$deviations.light-divider-and-pressed: Linear's light mode ships one surface (#F4F5F8), so bg-surface and bg-raised resolve to the same value there and selection is carried by the purple wash the spec does define. The pressed step and the divider are derived; no body text is placed on the pressed step.

light.$comment: Linear is dark-first and calls light a limited variant. It also inverts the elevation direction: the canvas is white and surfaces are tinted, which is the opposite of the dark ladder.
